summary: The installSnapshot check was executed by the trusted runner as check af5ed6e5cd714a38bc74fced5d1bbcc5 (exit 0, tests_passed, no target files changed) and recorded outcome violated with a complete witness; its only blocker was that direct oracle correspondence was unreviewed, and review_contract listed checker_correspondence as the required whole-artifact aspect. This turn submits that review: action=review on artifact 58ebdb2f92184614b01ecfab56fe2bc9 with one checker_correspondence item, status no_issue_found and no counterevidence (nothing contrary was observed, and reading the handler confirms there is no setLastLog on any path). The rationale walks the contract: the checked proposition and consequent; the real handler, snapshot store, FSM restore and log clear with the RPC dispatch layer named as the substituted edge and only the genuine runFSM consumer started; every declared input (snapshot version, term, Size, configuration, msgpack payload) accepted by the handler; the correlated admission (install_request) and oracle (store_after_install with install_succeeded=true) sharing identity 'node'; and the trusted observation raft_last_log_index=10, raft_last_log_term=1, raft_last_index=10, snapshot_index=4, snapshot_term=1, store_last_index=0, applied_index=4. The install restored the snapshot at index 4 and cleared the store to last index 0, yet the follower still reports log index 10 as its watermark, so it names an index the install removed - the direct negation of the claim rather than an artifact of the equality encoding. The original cause hypothesis (that the follower then misreports to the leader and cannot resume from the post-install nextIndex = S+1, and could campaign claiming entries it does not hold), the unproven reachability of a legal leader history producing watermark-above-snapshot, the non-monotonic compaction branch, and the equality-versus-lower-reset caveat are kept as explicit limitations rather than folded into the confirmed part. Chinese report_title/report_answer are presentation only. Preflight validation returns valid with no diagnostics; accepting this review should clear the correspondence blocker and record this as the second confirmed in-scope violation.
